bibleState.purpose: To chart the drowned coast before the crown's surveyors do, so that the new shoreline belongs to whoever mapped it first.
bibleState.membership: Former navy draughtsmen and their apprentices; a member is admitted on the strength of one finished chart and expelled for selling a chart outside the hall.

bibleState.internal_tension:
The older members want to sell the charts to the crown at a high price and retire. The apprentices want to keep them from the crown altogether and give them to the coastal villages for nothing.

Neither side has told the other what it intends.
